critical_code_review_comments: server.py L819-822 _mgmt_cannot_touch_admin is correctly invoked in reset/patch/delete/reactivate paths.

server.py L897-898 update_user separately blocks management from promoting anyone to admin — good, defense-in-depth beyond _mgmt_cannot_touch_admin (which only blocks touching a user whose CURRENT role is admin).
server.py L914-915 self-deactivation returns 400 before role check — correct order (own-account block is stronger than admin-touch block).
server.py L939-951 PATCH /me/profile whitelists exactly {name,phone,picture}. If only disallowed keys sent it 400s ('Nothing to update'). Role/email cannot be self-escalated — verified.
server.py L954-974 POST /me/picture uploads to object storage, records in files collection with is_public=True, then sets user.picture to /api/files/{id}/download — clean flow, no _id leak.
Users.jsx L41 canManageThis correctly disables kebab for admin rows when management is logged in — matches server-side 403 guards.
Users.jsx L42 availableRoles filter hides 'admin' from role dropdown for management — matches server-side 403 on create/patch admin.
Profile.jsx L40 pwValid + button disabled state prevents client-side submission with weak/mismatched password; live checklist gives clear UX.

Profile.jsx L30 pic URL rewrite ${API_BASE}${picture.replace('/api','')} is fragile if picture path doesn't start with /api (e.g. absolute S3 URL later) — it will fall through to the else branch OK, but consider a URL() check to be safer.
Users.jsx & Profile.jsx are both well under 700 lines and reuse Field/PasswordInput sub-components cleanly.
